input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred ASSIGN position in full. 24.1 lets Customer assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all assets without Vendor consent; 24.2 bars Vendor from assigning, delegating material performance, or transferring by change of control without Customer's prior written consent, with the consent standard qualified only by reasonableness, and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor; 24.3 applies a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld consent standard to other assignments; and 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on Customer's change of control, with no contrary trigger in Section 9 or elsewhere. Minor note only, not a deviation: the competitor prohibition in 24.2 is framed as "without Customer's consent" rather than absolute, but the gate remains entirely in our hands, and Vendor's subcontracting (Section 3) leaves Vendor fully responsible for its subcontractors. No redline required.
